# Full Bloom Counseling

> Full Bloom Counseling is a licensed group therapy practice in Denver, Colorado, founded by Rebecca Moravec, LPC, LMFT, AAMFT Approved Supervisor and Certified Narrative Enneagram Practitioner & Teacher. The practice serves Denver and all of Colorado via telehealth, offering trauma-informed, weight-inclusive, LGBTQ+ affirming care.

Website: <https://fullbloomcounseling.com>. Last updated: June 2026.

## About

Full Bloom Counseling is a group private practice of licensed clinicians offering compassionate, evidence-informed therapy for individuals, couples, and families. Approach: weight-inclusive, anti-diet, trauma-informed, LGBTQ+ affirming, and HAES-aligned. Modalities include EMDR, Brainspotting, the Safe and Sound Protocol (SSP), Narrative Therapy, the Gottman Method, ACT, CBT, and IFS. Insurance: out of network, with superbills provided and sliding scale available.

- [About Full Bloom](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/about/): practice story, philosophy, and team overview
- [Meet Our Therapists](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/therapists/): full clinician roster and specialties
- [Boulder Office](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/boulder/): in-person therapy in Boulder, CO with Kelsey Bennett, LPC (plus telehealth statewide)
- [Contact & Free Consultation](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/contact/): book a free 15-minute consultation
- [FAQs](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/faqs/): common questions about therapy, fees, and insurance

## Services

- [Individual Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/individual-therapy/): one-on-one therapy for anxiety, trauma, growth, and life transitions
- [Anxiety Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/anxiety-therapy/): EMDR, somatic, and evidence-based approaches for lasting relief
- [Trauma Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/trauma-therapy/): trauma-informed care including EMDR and SSP
- [Couples Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/couples-therapy/): Gottman Method and Emotionally Focused Therapy
- [Family Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/family-therapy/): connection and conflict resolution for families
- [EMDR Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/emdr/): Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing for trauma
- [Brainspotting Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/brainspotting-therapy/): brain-body trauma processing with a certified practitioner
- [Safe and Sound Protocol (SSP)](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/safe-and-sound/): nervous system regulation through listening therapy
- [Disordered Eating & Body Image](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/disordered-eating/): weight-inclusive support for disordered eating and body image
- [Health at Every Size (HAES)](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/health-at-every-size/): intuitive eating and body liberation counseling
- [Enneagram Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/enneagram-therapy/): Narrative Enneagram work with certified teachers
- [Grief & Loss Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/grief-loss-therapy/): support for grief that needs more than time
- [Pre-Marital Counseling](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/pre-marital/): Gottman-informed preparation for couples
- [Postpartum & Perinatal Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/postpartum-perinatal-therapy/): perinatal mood, anxiety, and adjustment support
- [Therapy for Women](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/therapy-for-women-denver/): therapy addressing anxiety, identity, and life transitions
- [Therapy for Men](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/therapy-for-men-denver/): therapy designed for how men actually engage
- [Therapy for Young Adults](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/therapy-young-adults-denver/): support through the challenges of your 20s
- [ADHD & Neurodivergent Therapy](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/adhd-neurodivergent-therapy-denver/): executive function and neurodivergent-affirming care
- [Online Therapy (Colorado)](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/online-therapy-colorado/): telehealth therapy throughout Colorado
- [Clinical Supervision](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/services/clinical-supervision/): LPC and LMFT supervision hours, AAMFT Approved

## Team

- [Rebecca Moravec, LPC, LMFT](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/team/rebecca-moravec/): Founder, AAMFT Approved Supervisor, Certified Narrative Enneagram Practitioner; trauma, couples, Enneagram, Intuitive Eating
- [Natalie Siegel, LPC](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/team/natalie-siegel/): Intuitive Eating, body image, anxiety, self-esteem

## Community Partnerships

Full Bloom partners with the Colorado Children's Chorale, a premier Denver-based children's choral organization that tours nationally and internationally. Full Bloom embeds a licensed clinician on every Chorale tour, and Becca Moravec developed a custom mental health handbook for the demands of touring with young singers.

- [Partnerships](https://fullbloomcounseling.com/partnerships/): community and organizational partnerships
- [Colorado Children's Chorale](https://www.childrenschorale.org): partner choral organization
